population.language_scope: javascript only — this repo is single-language. NO claim may be made about C++/clangd behaviour from this series; that requires the echoes carrier.

reference_set.authority: tree-sitter parse of source files. Independent of the graph index AND of grep.
known_limits: dynamically constructed or re-exported names are invisible to a syntactic parse
generated files are counted as source if present on disk; none are excluded by name
JS only — no C++/TS surfaces in scope, so no claim transfers to those
a declaration is function/generator/method/class declaration, or a const bound directly to a function/arrow
reference_set.shared_dependency_caveat: THE REFEREE SHARES A PARSER WITH ONE ARM. The graph indexer also uses tree-sitter, so this reference is independent of the graph INDEX STATE and QUERY PATH but NOT of tree-sitter parsing decisions. If tree-sitter misses a declaration, both miss it identically and the agreement below proves nothing about that case. A referee fully independent of both arms would need a different parser or a compiler front end.
